method: Inspected top-down root paths/body-heading arrows plus chronological rendered skeleton frames sampled at 2 fps for all 16 train-only QA clips.
observations: Samples show leg alternation with translated curved trajectories, including left/right bends and U-turns.
Small-angle threshold-edge cases include gentle bends and body/path angle mismatch within the stated tolerance; admission is not an exhaustive manual quality certificate.
No clip was relabeled as spin based solely on walking context. The stationary-turn rejection uses motion inside the rotation event.
scope: Source selection only. No model training, no old dataset replacement.
